points: PalletPoseNode::on_pair keeps every class-matched candidate in a local vector through publish_pose and publish_failure_diagnostics, then that vector is destroyed. extract_detection_candidates walks the Detection2DArray once, keeps the highest-scoring hypothesis per detection, and stores source_index as that detection's slot (skipped non-matches leave gaps). select_detection is one std::max_element and returns that DetectionCandidate by value. Default strategy highest_confidence ranks score, then area_px; largest_area swaps that key order. A full tie keeps the earlier candidate because max_element returns the first maximum, so the later tied candidate stays in the vector with the other non-selected candidates. An unknown strategy throws. There is no subset split. Two early returns publish nothing: an empty candidate list, and a depth_image_to_meters exception. estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 runs once, and only that source_index is stored as PoseResult.instance_id or FailureResult.instance_id. publish_pose writes PalletPoseStamped with yaw, face normal, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, chamfer_cost_m, and this pair's input_rgb_stamp and input_depth_stamp (det_msg->header.stamp and depth_msg->header.stamp; ApproximateTime queue 10, slop 0.10 s). The message ends at input_depth_stamp and has no source-index fields. publish_ok_diagnostics emits chamfer_cost_m, plane_inlier_ratio, n_face_points, and those two stamps. On estimate failure the only publish is publish_failure_diagnostics (failure_reason plus those two stamps); instance_id is not written and no PalletPoseStamped is published. Detector postprocess caps the list at max_detections 10, so ranking it is a few comparisons. Writing the one admitted source index and the not-admitted source indexes, still in that candidate-list order, onto PalletPoseStamped after input_depth_stamp, and the same two lists onto the failure diagnostic, is a few integers outside the chamfer loop. Calling estimate_pose_chamfer_v3_2 once per extra detection would repeat the 45700-evaluation search.

Measured stage-2 time is that single estimate. two_stage_chamfer_search_v2 always runs: free coarse is 21 x 31 x 31 = 20181 (±10 deg at 1 deg, ±0.15 m at 0.01 m) and free fine is 13 x 25 x 25 = 8125 (±1.2 deg at 0.2 deg, ±0.012 m at 0.001 m). two_stage_chamfer_search_v2_with_prior runs unless lambda_eff <= lambda_floor 0.05. confidence is clamp((0.020 - free_cost) / 0.014, 0, 1) and lambda_eff is prior_lambda 3.0 times (1 - confidence), so the prior is skipped only when free_cost is at or below 0.020 - 0.014 * (1 - 0.05/3) = 0.006233333333333334 m. The prior search is centered on the PCA init_pose, not on free_pose. Prior coarse is 21 x 21 x 21 = 9261 (±0.10 m at 0.01 m, same 21 yaw steps) plus another 8125 fine evaluations. The four grids are 45692 evaluations. Each of the four stage searches also evaluates its seed once before the parallel loop, and the zero-offset cell is inside the grid, so that seed is a second data cost. choose_pi_ambiguous_pose adds two full costs, the anchor chamfer_cost_v2 adds one and always runs before the lambda_eff branch, and a successful prior path adds one more data-only chamfer_cost_v2. The common frame when the prior runs is 45700 chamfer_cost_from_rotated evaluations. OpenMP schedule(static) splits that count across threads and does not drop evaluations; the critical section runs once per thread.

Each of those evaluations is O(N log N) with N=182. cached_prototype builds the default contour once and rebuilds it only when shape parameters change: 1.20 x 0.14 m outer face plus two 0.47 x 0.10 m pockets at contour_spacing_m 0.03, using n = max(2, ceil(length/spacing)+1) per edge with the endpoint omitted (94 + 44 + 44). rotate_proto_into writes the N x 2 rotation into thread-local ChamferTls.rotated once per theta (proto * R.transpose() only when theta changes). chamfer_cost_from_rotated still assigns tls.translated = rotated and adds tx, ty on every pose, sample_bilinear_into setConstant-fills the N distances then bilinear-samples all N, assign-copies them into tls.sorted, and std::sorts all N even though trim_fraction 0.10 sums only ceil(0.9*N) = 164. The bilinear reads are Eigen column-major points(i, 0) and points(i, 1), a stride of N doubles. At 45700 evaluations the translation copy is 133078400 bytes and the sort copy is 66539200 bytes, before the sort itself.

Before the grid, and only for the candidate select_detection already chose: depth_image_to_meters convertTo-copies the whole depth frame into a new CV_32FC1 once per synced pair (camera.yaml depth is 640x480; 16UC1 is scaled by depth_scale 0.001), so that copy does not multiply with deferred indexes. build_bbox_mask zero-fills a 1920x1080 mask and erodes it erode_px 2 times with a 3x3 kernel, even though only the bbox rectangle is set. sample_face_points scans every depth pixel, O(Hd*Wd) = 307200, with a K_inv ray, an SE(3) into RGB, and a lookup in that full mask; the bbox does not cull the depth loop. Accepted points go into per-thread std::vector<Eigen::Vector3d> buckets that together reserve Hd*Wd/4 (76800 Vector3d, about 1.8 MB) and are copied again, row by row, into points_depth_frame. ransac_plane_fit (up to ransac_iters 100, early stop at inlier ratio 0.85) allocates a residual array and a bool mask of length n_face_points every iteration, then copies inliers into a fresh matrix for JacobiSVD. plane_inlier_mask allocates those arrays again, and the pipeline copies the inliers a second time into plane_points_3d. project_points_to_plane_2d allocates an n_plane_inliers x 3 relative matrix and an n_plane_inliers x 2 result; PCA centres another n_plane_inliers x 2 copy. The distance image is built once per detection, not per pose. rasterize_points_to_mask uses resolution_m 0.005 and padding_m 0.80: a nominal 1.20 m by 0.14 m face is 561 by 350 (padded x span 2.8 m; padded y span 1.7400000000000002 m so ceil(span/0.005) is 349 and the +1 makes 350). close_mask clones the mask, runs a 5x5 elliptical MORPH_CLOSE (close_radius_px 2), then connectedComponentsWithStats and a second full-size mask. extract_boundary_mask erodes with a 3x3 kernel and builds another edge image. compute_distance_transform_v2 calls cv::distanceTransform with DIST_L2 and DIST_MASK_PRECISE and convertTo to CV_32FC1. The prototype cache does not reuse that distance image. These passes are smaller than the 45692-evaluation grid and would repeat for each extra posed detection.

Stage 1 is a separate process and is not where the admitted and deferred source indexes are published. rtdetr_detector_node defaults to backend mock, which skips inference copies. detector.yaml and full_pipeline.launch.py set backend tensorrt at input 640 with max_detections 10 and no NMS. On that path image_to_rgb copies msg.data via bytes() into a 1920x1080x3 array (about 6.2 MB; bgr8 reverses channels into a second array), preprocess resizes to 640x640 and builds a float32 CHW ascontiguousarray (1x3x640x640, about 4.9 MB), and TensorRTBackend.infer copies into pinned host memory, memcpy HtoD, execute_async_v3, memcpy DtoH, then copies labels, boxes, and scores back. That host traffic is upstream of the pair delivered to on_pair. The admission integers do not change it. geometry_core links Eigen3, OpenCV core/imgproc, yaml-cpp, and OpenMP; yaml-cpp loads the camera model only in the pose-node constructor, not per frame.
